activities.title: Oral Language Development: Community Circle Time
activities.content:
Greeting
• Welcome pupils and have them sit in a circle.
• Say: I ndopit kom ne fu siminir.O ɓay o ñamaak naa siminiteel. Yoɗ yo xa ƥay xa 
ñamaak nuun.
• Check to make sure every pupil is holding up the right hand.
• Say: Mbanuu siminoona o kiin, ɗeeti mbaamirum a paax, o lay gonum, koy siminin 
fu yar. 
• Turn to the pupil on your right, shake their hand.
• Say: Nu mbeede jam, (layi gon le no caajang ohe).
• Pupil should respond back saying "Good morning, teacher."
•  Have the pupil that was just greeted, turn to the pupil on their right and greet 
them. This continues all the way around the circle.
Theme Discussion
• Before school starts, bring in two items related to the theme to show the pupils. 
Put the items in the center of the circle. If no items are available, draw two 
pictures on the board instead.
• Say: Nu xooxkom leek, xoox le na cangee refu "O nged". Tikoorik ke ndefna yo no 
saaxeek fop a mbogayo nu xoox le na cangee.
• Hold up one of the items from the center of the circle. 
• Say: keek haroo?
•    Call on a pupil at random to answer. 
•    Say: Har waagaxamo o lay nu keek?
• Call on 2-3 pupils at random to answer. Repeat with the second item.
• Say: Har tikoorik keek a mbogu yo fu 'o nged? 
• Give pupils one minute to think, even close their eyes to picture their response. 

Then choose one of the following options for discussion: call on pupils at random, 
Turn and Talk (have pupils turn to a pupil next to them), go around the circle and 
allow every pupil to answer (only if the answer is short), or have pupils take turns 
acting out answers.
• Encourage pupils to bring in their own items relating to the theme throughout the 
week.

activities.title: Letter of the Week
activities.content:
Learning Letter: "a" 
• Write the small letter "a" very big on the board. Point to the letter.

• Say: Han i ngim a kim, na pind o leng o leng. Keek hana damit a in bo i mbaag o 
leem xa qiiƈ ake o leng o leng. Keek hana damit a in bo i mbaag o jang xa nanel xa 
qiiƈ in.
• Point to the letter on the board or letter card, say the sound, have pupils repeat 3 
times slowly.
• Write the capital letter "A" very big on the board. Point to the capital letter.
• Say: Keek o hiiƈ o lengoo. O ten refu o nanelee /a/. A naanga o ropaa o ɗelem, gon 
no kiin, mbaa a palaas. 
• Point to the letter on the board or letter card, say the sound, have pupils repeat 3 
times slowly.
• Point to the small letter "a" on the board or letter card again. 
• Say: Ke moƴna may, a naanga refaa na xa ñuxur.

activities.title: Writing
activities.content:
Fine Motor Development
• Say: Han i njofdan xa ƈoox ake na xa ƥay in fa xa ƥaal in. Keek hana damit a in bo i 
mbaag a pind a paax. Ne xa ƈoox xa ƥay in a saƭikit na rek, i moƴ kaa yo o mbaag o 
mbindit xa ƥay in. 
• Exercise is marching: standing in place the opposite arm swings forward to the 
raised knee(left arm and right knee together). As pupils march on the spot, give 
orders: low march knees raised slightly), normal march (knees raised to half 
raised), high march (knees raised as high as possible), left turn, right turn, face 
forward.
• Alternative exercise is the crab walk: (make sure the ground is not dirty so pupils 
do not soil their clothes) sit on the ground with legs extended out in front, place 
hands by side with fingers pointed toward feet, lift body up into the air, start 
moving forward or backwards. Have pupils try for one minute then have them stop 
and rest for a minute.
• Then have them try again for another minute.

activities.title: Vocabulary
activities.content:
Teach and Discuss New Words
• Words: 
koy   ɓanaana
• Say: I njang xa ñuxur xa qas ndax te damit a in i mbaag o and a naxee a paax. A 
jega xa ñuxur xa peeñu kaa i mbar na yo o njang na naxee. 
• Say the first vocabulary word, but do not write it on the board. Then have pupils 
say the word aloud. Repeat two more times.
• Ask pupils what they know about the word. Share the meaning of the word, using 
gestures or illustrations to support understanding. 
• If needed, help pupils understand the word by saying it in another language.
• Repeat all steps with remaining word.

activities.title: Before Reading & Reason to Read
activities.content:
Learn New Print Concepts
• Think about how we read a book. Show the cover.
• Say: I naangaa niira yo, i niiritoo took ngar a lang i njoox fa ƥay i supit a lafee 
ngotin nu njasnoor ndet a cinj. (demonstrate).
• Have pupils follow the motions as you show on the book TOP to BOTTOM and 
RIGHT to LEFT and turn pages FRONT to BACK.

activities.title: Comprehension
activities.content:
Making Predictions: Picture Walk 
• Say: I ƭeet a ngaa nataal kaa yoona yo fa a nax, hana mbaag a in o ndamit bo in 
njeg pexe nu ne a naxee a nand kaa. Keek refu o foog kenaa xew kaa na naxee. 
Yoqke o foog a waaga o jof mbaa te ñak o jof, ndaa fop a njega o njiriñ. O haa 
waag na niir a paax hana waag o lay kenaa xew kaa na naxee.
• Read the title of the story. Look at the illustration.

• Say: Foogaamee a naxeek a nax no ƥiy o ngoor o ngaa bugna ñaam a ƥanaana yoo. 
Foogaamee ke taxna bo keek a jega refu o ƥiy o ngoor o nge a ahe ɗeetaa nduŋ 
ƥanaana ne koy a xelaataa ne te ɗatit kan took ndaxar ne.
• Continue through the book. Stop at each picture but do not read the story.
• Say: Nu ƭeeta ngaa nataal neek fog na fa naxee, har nu mboogu yee o ten naa xew 
kaa? 
• Give pupils less than a minute to look, then call on a pupil at random asking for 
their prediction. Then call on another pupil at random asking for their prediction. 
If pupils are having difficulty making a prediction, share one of your own.
• Say: Ga' aam o ƥiy o ngoor a saq nduŋ a ƥanaana took ndaxar ƥanaana nu nataal 
neek. 
 
Vocabulary Review
• On the pages that have a vocabulary word, stop and draw pupil attention to the 
word. 
• Say: Tam i nga'u yo o ñuxur o feeñu leek 'ɓaanana' nu nataal neek?
• Call on a pupil at random. Affirm the correct answer or attempt, let them know if 
it is correct, and clarify the answer. If pupils have trouble finding the word in the 
picture, remind them of the meaning of the word.

• Ask pupils what they know about the word. Share the meaning of the word, using 
gestures or illustrations to support understanding. 
• If needed, help pupils understand the word by saying it in another language.
• Repeat all steps with remaining word(s).

activities.title: Comprehension: Before Reading
activities.content:
Making Predictions: Illustration
• Show the illustration. Read the title while pointing to each word. 
• Say: I ƭeetoo nataal neek . Har nu nga'u yo?
• Give the pupils a minute to look and think. Call on a pupil at random asking for 
their answer.
• Say: Fat i ƥaat o ƭeet nataal ne koy i ngelaat har naa xew kaa. Har nu mboogu yee 

ten naa xew kaa na naxee? Mbuul yo a kid nuun koy nu ngelaat kenu mboog na yee 
o ten naa xew kaa.
• Give the pupils a minute to look and think. Call on a pupil at random asking for 
their prediction. After the answer, ask why they made the prediction.

activities.title: Comprehension: During Reading
activities.content:
Read Aloud
• Read aloud the story. Stop after a few pages/sentences.
• Say: Har foogo yee o ten naa xew kaa? Mbuul yo a kid nuun koy nu ngelaat kenu 
mboog na yee o ten naa xew kaa.
• Call on a pupil at random to give their prediction. Stop 2-3 times during the story. 
Jaalo Bugee o ɗaan
 Jaalo a ŋasee ga yii a wirlooxaa fu a oto a ŋasir mee. Jaalo bugee o wondoox. 
Yaayum a layinee, "Waxtu a ƭaan a fada." Ndaa Jaalo a burle a ŋasaa a wirlooxaa 
fu a oto ŋasir mee. Yaayum a layinee, "Reti sooc a ñiin fa ke!" Ndaa Jaalo a burle 
a ŋasaa fa oto mee. "Yaayum a layee, "Waasi o ŋas o nge too ret wondooxik!" Bo 
ndiiki, Jaalo a ŋasaa fa oto mee. Yaayum a layinee "Han layon a nax." Jaalo a was 
o ŋas o nge, a geek a oto
 ŋasirumee, koy a pare. Jaalo a fool took njoŋ ne koy a wondoox. Jaalo a pare pur 
te nangiloox a naxee. Yaayum a rop a nax ale koy a layee, "Meen a reɗ'u reeɗ…."

activities.title: Comprehension: After Reading
activities.content:
Prediction Check
• Remind the class what they predicted would happen based on the illustration. Ask 
the pupils if that's what happened? After the response, affirm the correct answer 
or attempt, let them know if it is correct, and clarify the answer.
Factual Questions: Who and What?
• Show the illustration.
• A kaangaam mbaa ƥaaɓaan num refu na naxee? (Answer: Jaalo)
• Call on a pupil at random to answer. Affirm the correct answer or attempt, let 
them know if it is correct, and clarify the answer.
• Say: A kangaam ake na naxee a njega yo calel den. Keek refu mañeer den. Keek 
refu ke a kagaam ake a mbiyaa yo na naxale. Har a kagaam ake a mbiyaa yo nu 
nataal ne?
• Call on a pupil at random to answer the question. Affirm the correct answer or 
attempt, let them know if it is correct, and clarify the answer.
• Say: O ñuxuree 'har' refu mañeer ke a kagaam ake a mbiyaa kam a naxee, mbaa ke 
refna xewaa na naxee.
• Point to the character's name in the story. Call on a pupil at random to come and 
point to the character in the picture. Find the character's action in the story.

activities.title: Oral Language Development: Community Circle Time
activities.content:
Greeting
• Welcome pupils and have them sit in a circle. 
• Follow the normal greeting routine.
• Have the pupil that was just greeted, turn to the pupil on their right and greet 
them. This continues all the way around the circle.
Theme Discussion
• Before school starts, bring in two items related to the theme to show the pupils. 
Put the items in the center of the circle. If no items are available, draw two 
pictures on the board instead.
• Say: Nu xooxkom leek, xoox a cang inee refu 'Lak ke nu ngenand in .' Tikoorik ke 
na karta ale yoona yo fu xoox le na cangee.
• Hold up one of the items from the center of the circle. 
• Say: Keek haroo?
• Call on a pupil at random to answer.
• Say: Har waagaxamo o lay nu keek?
• Call on 2-3 pupils at random to answer. Repeat with the second item. 
• Say: A nax a lum foogo yee ten yaay fee a naxanu a Jaalo?
• Give pupils one minute to think, even close their eyes to picture their response. 
Then choose one of the following options for discussion: call on pupils at random, 
Turn and Talk (have pupils turn to a pupil next to them), go around the circle and 
allow every pupil to answer (only if the answer is short), or have pupils take turns 
acting out answers.
• Encourage pupils to bring in their own items relating to the theme throughout the 
week.

• Say: In layangaa nuun nee nu ngar nu njasnoor koy, ƭeet a kon nuun. Nu nga'a 
ngaan, njil yo a karta le koy nu atiidin mena mi. 

• Have pupils come up 2-3 at a time. When they bring you their card, point to their 
name and as they say it move your finger along the letters. Then have the pupil 
tap the syllables in their name.

activities.content:
Learning Letter "j"
• Write the small letter "j" very big on the board. Point to the letter.
• Say: Keek refu o hiiƈee nu xooxkom le. O hiiƈeek o nanelum refu /j/. I layandoor o 
nanelee /j/. 
• Hold up the letter card.
• Say: O nanel /j/ ropu o ñuxuree (jaf).

activities.title: Writing
activities.content:
Learning Writing Concepts
• Say: Kaa i njang kaa yo pur nu njeem nen naa binteel. Balaa in ndopaa, han I 
suminoox mbaa I letin xa ƥay in.
• Warm up exercise: have pupils push their palms together as hard as they can for 
10 seconds. Then release and shake hands for 10 seconds. Repeat two more times.
• Give each pupil a pencil and demonstrate the proper way to hold a pencil.
• Say: I naangaa mbindaa yo, i mbindit nu njanoon ndet ñamaak koy ngotit took 
ngar a lang. A nanda nen o dam pindir koy o ɓisaa o ɓayof took. Ndiiki, fat i njeem 
mbindit njanoon ndet nu ñamaak koy I ndet took ngar a lang, kom ne i mbi'tanoo 
na kayit.
• Go through the motions of moving a pencil in the air. Pupils follow you. Have the 
pupils make specific motions like dashes or loops. Look around and make sure 
pupils are going in the proper direction (left to right, then moving down as if 
moving to a new line).
• Demonstrate on the board.
• Say: Ndiiki, fat i njeem took a taabul in ake. Njang yo pindir kom a pensil koy nu 
ndopit took nu njanoon. Mbi'yo xa ƥay nuun kom nuun we mbindaa took a tabulee. 
Nu mbadangaa mete fod na, nu ndet no lakasee. Mburle yo mbind ngotit njanoon 
ndet nu ñamaak, took ndet a lang.
• Walk around and make sure pupils are making marks from left to right. Continue 
to the next line, stopping to check pupil progress before going on.
